      (CAST ( "activities"."start_local"::date AS date ) < CAST ( '2026-10-22' AS date ))

    ("activities"."avg_speed_ms" > 0) AND
    ("activities"."avg_hr" > 0) AND
    ("activities"."moving_time_s" > 0)
  GROUP BY
